headline: Veritas Legal, Norton Rose Fulbright, Freshfields act on Aegis Logistics' $809 million majority stake acquisition in Tristar Holdings
sum: Aegis Logistics Limited has acquired an 89.8% stake in Tristar Holdings Limited for a consideration of $809 million. Veritas Legal advised Aegis Logistics on this acquisition.
detail: Aegis Logistics Limited has acquired an 89.8% stake in Tristar Holdings Limited for a consideration of $809 million. Veritas Legal advised Aegis Logistics on this acquisition. The transaction team consisted of Abhijit Joshi (Founding & Managing Partner), Rustam Mulla (Senior Partner), Kunal Doshi (Senior Partner), Kanisha Vora (Partner), Jhinook Roy (Partner & Head - Projects, Infrastructure and Finance) and Aditya Thakore (Principal Associate). They were supported by the following: Due diligence team: Parshva Doshi, Aditya Macedo, Avantika Mehndiratta, Hriday Chokshi, Vanshika Katiyar, Afrrin Advani, Aryan Mehta, Himani Choudhary, Karan Dhoria, Pratham Gupta, Sumanyu Mohanty, Nived Sharma,…
